name: GoRetroid (Retroid)
method_rationale: Shopify's documented public /products.json. Verified 200 on 2026-07-28. Chosen over HTML parsing: structured, stable, and not an anti-bot arms race.

name: DROIX
method_rationale: Returns 403 to direct requests on both droix.co.uk and droix.net (verified 2026-07-28). No public structured endpoint found. Kept in the merchant set deliberately: it is the only source that requires a paid managed provider, and therefore the only place a real cost-per-successful-parse figure can be measured. Disabled until a provider is chosen and credentialed.
